sentences.en: There is a big stack of mail on the table.
sentences.zh: 桌子上有厚厚一叠信件。

sentences.en: They're on top of the books stacked in the corner.
sentences.zh: 它们堆在角落里的书上面。

sentences.en: Yanni walked through the mosque with a stack of books.
sentences.zh: 雅尼穿过清真寺时手里拿着一摞书。
